findings.highlight: mysterious when it comes to promoting her own daughter
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に得体の知れない母親にしてプロモーターだ
findings.explanation: Youko is unfathomable both as a mother and as a promoter. The translation confines the mystery to how she promotes her daughter, losing Haruki's broader unease about how much she knows and controls.
findings.japanese:
一体、俺たちのことを何処まで掴んでるのか…
本当に得体の知れない母親にしてプロモーターだ。
findings.todokanai: I wonder how much she knows about us… She really is very mysterious when it comes to promoting her own daughter.

findings.highlight: until her last concert
findings.evidenceJa: 追加公演が終わるまで
findings.explanation: The contract lasts until the additional performance ends. Calling it her 'last concert' asserts finality not present in the term and obscures the production's repeated distinction between scheduled and additional performances.
findings.japanese:
「冬馬かずさ独占取材は、
一応、追加公演が終わるまでって契約になってる」
findings.todokanai: "The contract that allows us exclusive coverage on Touma Kazusa will last until her last concert."

findings.highlight: the first time since that night when we have fulfilled our one week rule in Tokyo
findings.evidenceJa: 東京では一月ぶりの“一週間ルール”を果たす日
findings.explanation: This is their first Tokyo observance of the weekly rule in a month, as well as the first since the Osaka night. The translation drops the explicit one-month gap.
findings.japanese:
今日は、あの夜以来の、
東京では一月ぶりの“一週間ルール”を果たす日。
findings.todokanai: Today is the first time since that night when we have fulfilled our one week rule in Tokyo.

findings.highlight: But the apartment next to mine…
findings.evidenceJa: けれど、今の俺の部屋は。その隣は…
findings.explanation: Haruki breaks off over both his room as it now is and the room next door, because Setsuna's return home will expose Kazusa's proximity and traces. The translation deletes the first room and reduces the double threat to the neighbor alone.
findings.japanese:
けれど、今の俺の部屋は。
その隣は…
findings.todokanai: But the apartment next to mine…

findings.highlight: having a strong sense of responsibility
findings.evidenceJa: 生活感たっぷりな、いつもの雪菜だよ
findings.explanation: Haruki teases Setsuna for being thoroughly practical and redolent of everyday domestic life. A 'strong sense of responsibility' turns that concrete, slightly dowdy household quality into an abstract virtue.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、いつも通りだ。
ケチケチしてて、所帯じみてて、生活感たっぷりな、
いつもの雪菜だよ」
findings.todokanai: "Yes, just like always. Stingy, family-oriented, and having a strong sense of responsibility, just like the usual Setsuna."

findings.highlight: after I repair my reputation
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの名誉回復してからにしてよ
findings.explanation: Setsuna demands that Haruki restore her reputation after calling her stingy and old-fashioned before they go shopping. The translation makes Setsuna responsible for repairing her own reputation.
findings.japanese:
「も、もう！
わたしの名誉回復してからにしてよ～！」
findings.todokanai: "J-Jeez! We can do that after I repair my reputation!"

findings.highlight: I love how she's overly familial. I love how she's just so rigid.
findings.evidenceJa: 所帯じみてる雪菜が。生活臭漂う雪菜が
findings.explanation: Haruki loves Setsuna's settled, housewifely air and the palpable scent of everyday life around her. 'Familial' and especially 'rigid' discard the domestic imagery that makes her feel like home.
findings.japanese:
ケチケチしてる雪菜が。
所帯じみてる雪菜が。
生活臭漂う雪菜が。
findings.todokanai: I love how stingy Setsuna is. I love how she's overly familial. I love how she's just so rigid.

findings.highlight: we decided on 4 PM
findings.evidenceJa: 午後４時からでお願いしますとのことでした
findings.explanation: Kimura's email says they request that Monday's meeting begin at 4 p.m. The voicemail does not report a mutual decision; its phrasing is deliberately constructed to hide a code number.
findings.japanese:
「あ、北原です。先ほど吉浜エンジニアリングの
木村さんからメールがありまして、月曜の打ち合わせの件、
午後４時からでお願いしますとのことでした」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, it's me, Kitahara. Some time ago I got an email from Kimura-san at Yoshihama Engineering. On the matter of the appointment on Monday, we decided on 4 PM."

findings.highlight: Before confirming my prediction from three seconds ago.
findings.evidenceJa: 三秒前の予想を簡単に正解にしてしまう。俺を、求めてくれる
findings.explanation: By looking up and closing her eyes, Setsuna easily proves Haruki's three-second-old prediction correct: she wants him. 'Before confirming' leaves the sentence fragment logically inverted and detaches her desire from the confirmation.
findings.japanese:
なんて、三秒前の予想を簡単に正解にしてしまう。
俺を、求めてくれる。
findings.todokanai: …Before confirming my prediction from three seconds ago. Setsuna desires me.

findings.highlight: Normally, I would pull up her shirt
findings.evidenceJa: 多分俺はここでキスを続けたまま、雪菜の服をたくし上げ、軽く愛撫する
findings.explanation: Haruki predicts what he will probably do here and now if the kiss continues. 'Normally' reframes the imagined next step as a general sexual routine rather than the immediate choice he fears making.
findings.japanese:
多分俺はここでキスを続けたまま、
雪菜の服をたくし上げ、軽く愛撫する。
findings.todokanai: Normally, I would pull up her shirt and caress her as I'm still kissing her.

findings.highlight: fall down on the bed with her under me
findings.evidenceJa: 抱きかかえ、ベッドまで運び、仰向けに寝かせる
findings.explanation: He imagines picking Setsuna up, carrying her to the bed, and laying her on her back. The translation replaces those deliberate actions with both of them falling onto the bed.
findings.japanese:
唇を繋げたまま抱きかかえ、
ベッドまで運び、仰向けに寝かせる。
findings.todokanai: I'd embrace her as my lips are still attached to hers, and fall down on the bed with her under me.

findings.highlight: I'd take off her shirt, make her take off mine
findings.evidenceJa: 服を脱いで、脱がせて
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines undressing himself and undressing Setsuna. The translation limits both to shirts, assigns his undressing to Setsuna, and adds coercive 'make her.'
findings.japanese:
服を脱いで、脱がせて、
優しく、激しく交わり…
findings.todokanai: I'd take off her shirt, make her take off mine, then gently yet fervently make love with her…

findings.highlight: we'd take a shower
findings.evidenceJa: 二人一緒に風呂に入る
findings.explanation: They would enter the bath together after enjoying the afterglow. A shower changes the established shared bathing routine and its intimacy.
findings.japanese:
果てた後、しばらく余韻を楽しんだら、
二人一緒に風呂に入る。
findings.todokanai: Once we were done and finished enjoying the afterglow, we'd take a shower.

findings.highlight: The keyword that represents the most despicable thing possible.
findings.evidenceJa: 最低の最低を上塗りするときの、キーワード
findings.explanation: Four is the keyword Haruki uses when adding another layer of vileness atop the very worst—sending Kazusa away so he can sleep with Setsuna. The translation turns it into an abstract label and loses the repeated act of compounding betrayal.
findings.japanese:
そして４は………『一晩部屋を空けてくれ』。
最低の最低を上塗りするときの、キーワード。
findings.todokanai: And 4 is "Leave the apartment tonight." The keyword that represents the most despicable thing possible.

findings.highlight: You're together until Saturday morning
findings.evidenceJa: 土曜は、朝からずっと一緒なんだろ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki and Setsuna spend all of Saturday together starting in the morning. 'Until Saturday morning' ends their time when the source says it begins, materially changing the weekly arrangement.
findings.japanese:
「週末には、必ず会ってるんだろ？
土曜は、朝からずっと一緒なんだろ？
金曜の夜は………泊めるんだろ？」
findings.todokanai: "You always see her on the weekends, right? You're together until Saturday morning, right? And on Friday night… you always let her stay, right?"

findings.highlight: has finally returned to us
findings.evidenceJa: 一月がかりでようやく戻ってきた
findings.explanation: It took an entire month for Haruki and Setsuna to restore last year's weekly pattern. The translation omits that slow month-long recovery.
findings.japanese:
昨年までは、毎週のように繰り返してた生活パターンに、
一月がかりでようやく戻ってきた。
findings.todokanai: The lifestyle we had repeated almost every week last year has finally returned to us.

findings.highlight: I can manage to stay in Setsuna's room overnight all the time
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜を大っぴらに部屋に泊めることもできる
findings.explanation: Because the Ogiisos discuss sex openly, Haruki can openly have Setsuna stay overnight in his own room. The translation reverses host and guest and moves Haruki into Setsuna's family bedroom.
findings.japanese:
…まぁ、逆にこういう一家だからこそ、
雪菜を大っぴらに部屋に泊めることもできるんだけど。
findings.todokanai: …Well, on the other hand, it's precisely because this family is the way it is that I can manage to stay in Setsuna's room overnight all the time.

findings.highlight: Setsuna and I look at each other in confusion
findings.evidenceJa: 何のことかと雪菜に目配せしたけれど、それは完全に空振りに終わってしまった
findings.explanation: Haruki sends Setsuna a glance asking what the family means, but gets no response because she looks down in acute embarrassment. The translation makes both mutually confused, falsely erasing Setsuna's awareness of the ring discussion.
findings.japanese:
何のことかと雪菜に目配せしたけれど、
それは完全に空振りに終わってしまった。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna and I look at each other in confusion in an attempt to see if the other understands what's going on, but the effort is in vain.

findings.highlight: there is no need for us to find out over dinner
findings.evidenceJa: そういう身も蓋もないことを食事中にバラさなくても
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother says Takahiro need not expose such brutally frank behind-the-scenes details during dinner. The family already knows; the translation wrongly says dinner is when they would find out.
findings.japanese:
「…ええと。
だからそういう身も蓋もないことを
食事中にバラさなくても、ねぇ？」
findings.todokanai: "…Ehm, that doesn't mean you should be so blunt about it, and there is no need for us to find out over dinner."

findings.highlight: Amidst this heavy atmosphere
findings.evidenceJa: この、軽くて浮き足立った雰囲気の中でも
findings.explanation: The atmosphere is light and excited, almost giddy with wedding speculation. Calling it heavy reverses the social mood against which Haruki's sunken silence stands out.
findings.japanese:
この、軽くて浮き足立った雰囲気の中でも。
一世一代の決め所かもしれなかった場面でも…
findings.todokanai: Amidst this heavy atmosphere, and in this place where my once in a lifetime choice could be made…

findings.highlight: it was probably the best way to go about it
findings.evidenceJa: 正式に申し込むべき話の流れだった
findings.explanation: The conversation had reached a point where Haruki should formally make the proposal or request for Setsuna's hand. The translation turns that concrete obligation into a vague 'best way' and loses why his silence is a fatal mistake.
findings.japanese:
気が早すぎても、問題ないはずだった。
それどころか、正式に申し込むべき話の流れだった。
findings.todokanai: There shouldn't be anything wrong with being eager. In fact, it was probably the best way to go about it.

findings.highlight: Setsuna's mother started talking about the future of the household, putting her in direct opposition to the children who insisted on talking about that with only the family around.
findings.evidenceJa: もう親戚の予定を気にしだして、『内輪で』を多用する若手組と真っ向から対立し
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother is already checking relatives' schedules, while the younger group repeatedly advocates keeping the ceremony private or within a small circle. The translation replaces both concrete wedding-planning positions with generic household future talk.
findings.japanese:
お母さんは、もう親戚の予定を気にしだして、
『内輪で』を多用する若手組と真っ向から対立し。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna's mother started talking about the future of the household, putting her in direct opposition to the children who insisted on talking about that with only the family around.

findings.highlight: needing to talk to my mother
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の母親に一度会う必要がある
findings.explanation: Setsuna's father says he needs to meet Haruki's mother at least once, a formal family step. The translation reduces this to talking with her and loses the in-person obligation.
findings.japanese:
お父さんはそういう話には参加したがらなかったけれど、
去り際、俺の母親に一度会う必要があると呟いた。
findings.todokanai: Her father didn't seem to want to join the conversation, but when I was about to leave, he muttered to me about needing to talk to my mother.

findings.highlight: I was supposed to be taken aback by this family
findings.evidenceJa: すこし辟易しつつ、少し羨望を抱き
findings.explanation: Haruki expected to feel a little fed up with their entangling family talk while also envying it. 'Taken aback' loses his weary resistance to the very ties he hoped would absorb him.
findings.japanese:
すこし辟易しつつ、少し羨望を抱き、
そして徐々に、自分も染まっていくはずだったのに。
findings.todokanai: I was supposed to be taken aback by this family, feel envious, and then I'd eventually join them.

findings.highlight: I was just on my way to the station right now
findings.evidenceJa: あたしも今、ちょうど駅に着いたところでさ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she herself has just arrived at the station. The translation says she is still traveling toward it, contradicting her physical presence there.
findings.japanese:
「なんてな…ははっ、信じたか？
本当は、金曜からまだ一度も部屋に帰ってないんだ。
あたしも今、ちょうど駅に着いたところでさ」
findings.todokanai: "Just kidding… haha! Did you actually believe that? I actually haven't been in my apartment since Friday. I was just on my way to the station right now."

findings.highlight: I want her to finally stop using "I'm cold" to fool me someday.
findings.evidenceJa: いつか『寒いから』だけでは誤魔化しきれなくなるから
findings.explanation: Haruki fears that someday Kazusa will no longer be able to pass all her trembling and tears off as merely caused by cold. The translation makes this a wish that she stop fooling him, reversing his anxious forecast into a demand.
findings.japanese: いつか『寒いから』だけでは誤魔化しきれなくなるから。
findings.todokanai: I want her to finally stop using "I'm cold" to fool me someday.

findings.highlight: I can manage it at home
findings.evidenceJa: 少しだけ仕事残ってるけど、出なくてもなんとかなる
findings.explanation: Haruki has some work left but can manage without going into the office. The translation invents that he will do it at home, which changes whether Sunday remains wholly Kazusa's.
findings.japanese:
「大丈夫。
少しだけ仕事残ってるけど、
出なくてもなんとかなる」
findings.todokanai: "It's alright, I have a bit of work left to do, but I can manage it at home."

findings.highlight: You ran away from my concert
findings.evidenceJa: 好きだったはずのあたしのピアノから、逃げ出した
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki ran from her piano—the thing he supposedly loved—not specifically from a concert. The instrument and her music are the emotional object of his avoidance; narrowing it to an event weakens that accusation.
findings.japanese:
「でも春希は逃げた。
好きだったはずのあたしのピアノから、逃げ出した…」
findings.todokanai: "But you ran away, Haruki. You ran away from my concert that you supposedly loved so much…"

findings.highlight: her hand, which was already almost squeezing mine. She pulls my shoulder to her body
findings.evidenceJa: 未だに引きつるはずの右手にしっかり力を入れ、俺の肩に身体を寄せ
findings.explanation: Kazusa puts firm strength into the right hand that should still be twinging, then leans her body against Haruki's shoulder. The translation invents prior squeezing and has her pull his shoulder instead of moving herself close.
findings.japanese:
未だに引きつるはずの右手にしっかり力を入れ、
俺の肩に身体を寄せ、体温を伝え合う。
findings.todokanai: She puts even more force into her hand, which was already almost squeezing mine. She pulls my shoulder to her body, and we feel each other's warmth.

findings.highlight: I'll simply pass it off as something beyond my ability
findings.evidenceJa: その結果叩かれても仕方ないってくらい頑張るよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa will give everything and work so hard that, if the result is still criticized, she can accept that it cannot be helped. The translation says she will dismiss dissatisfaction as beyond her ability, replacing resolve with excuse-making.
findings.japanese:
「持てる力を出し切ってさ、
その結果叩かれても仕方ないってくらい頑張るよ」
findings.todokanai: "I'll make use of all the strength I have. I'll work so hard that if someone is still not satisfied despite that, I'll simply pass it off as something beyond my ability."

findings.highlight: make this winter a pleasant one
findings.evidenceJa: この冬だけは、お前もいいことにしてくれ
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks Haruki, just for this winter, to decide that being the worst is acceptable too. She is asking him to permit their wrongness, not to make the season pleasant.
findings.japanese:
「最低でも、あたしはいい。
…だから、頼む。
この冬だけは、お前もいいことにしてくれ」
findings.todokanai: "I don't mind being despicable… so please, make this winter a pleasant one."

findings.highlight: My apartment is only five minutes away
findings.evidenceJa: ここから俺たちの部屋まで、歩いて５分もかからない
findings.explanation: Their rooms—the paired apartments that now constitute their secret domestic space—are under five minutes away. Singular 'my apartment' removes Kazusa's neighboring room from the shared destination.
findings.japanese:
ここから俺たちの部屋まで、
歩いて５分もかからないのに…
findings.todokanai: My apartment is only five minutes away…

findings.highlight: I've looked at you longer than you have looked at yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: お前よりも、お前のこと見てるんだぞ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she watches Haruki more than he watches or understands himself, asserting perceptiveness. The translation changes comparative intensity into elapsed duration.
findings.japanese:
「ずっとお前のこと見つめてるんだぞ？
お前よりも、お前のこと見てるんだぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "I've always looked at you, you know? I've looked at you longer than you have looked at yourself."

findings.highlight: one obvious lie after the next
findings.evidenceJa: あんなに最低な嘘を重ねたのに
findings.explanation: Haruki has piled up so many despicable lies; 最低 condemns their morality, not their transparency. Calling them obvious undercuts the next question about why his lying skill has not improved.
findings.japanese:
あんなに最低な嘘を重ねたのに。
何度も騙し続けたのに。
findings.todokanai: I told one obvious lie after the next, yet still managed to deceive her.

findings.highlight: until I told you myself in the end, you never found out
findings.evidenceJa: 自分からバラすまでは、最後まで相手に気づかれなかったよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the other person she deceived did not notice until Kazusa herself revealed the truth. 相手 is not Haruki, as his following questions struggle to identify whom she means. The translation answers that mystery prematurely by making him the deceived person.
findings.japanese:
「五年前もさ…
結局、自分からバラすまでは、
最後まで相手に気づかれなかったよ」
findings.todokanai: "Five years ago… until I told you myself in the end, you never found out."

findings.highlight: that you love me more than anyone else
findings.evidenceJa: あたしのこと好きだって、愛してるって、ずっと昔から、変わらぬ気持ちのままだって
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks for lies that he likes her, loves her, and has felt unchanged since long ago. She does not ask him to rank her above everyone else; that added superlative destabilizes the carefully partitioned Setsuna/Kazusa arrangement.
findings.japanese:
「あたしのこと好きだって、愛してるって、
ずっと昔から、変わらぬ気持ちのままだって…」
findings.todokanai: "If you were to tell me that you love me, that you love me more than anyone else, that your feelings for me haven't changed one bit…"

findings.highlight: Because you'll still be able to love Setsuna. Because there'll still be a you who doesn't love me.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜のことを愛してる春希が現実にいるから。あたしのことを愛してない春希が日常にいるから
findings.explanation: Kazusa grounds her safety in a present reality where Haruki loves Setsuna and an everyday life where Haruki does not love Kazusa. The translation turns the first into future ability and loses the explicit reality-versus-daily-life partition.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜のことを愛してる春希が現実にいるから。
あたしのことを愛してない春希が日常にいるから」
findings.todokanai: "Because you'll still be able to love Setsuna. Because there'll still be a you who doesn't love me."

findings.highlight: She is pouring all her strength into embracing me.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が、力いっぱい抱きしめてる
findings.explanation: Kazusa clings to Haruki, while Haruki is the one embracing her with all his strength. The translation assigns both actions to Kazusa and erases his bodily answer to her plea.
findings.japanese:
かずさが、俺にすがりついてる。
俺が、力いっぱい抱きしめてる。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa is clinging to me. She is pouring all her strength into embracing me.

findings.highlight: What we'll do from now on will be nothing but a conditional reflex.
findings.evidenceJa: これはただの、条件反射なんだから
findings.explanation: Haruki insists that this—the declarations and embrace occurring now—is merely a conditioned reflex because it is a lie. The translation projects the claim onto unspecified future acts and weakens the immediate self-deception.
findings.japanese:
だって、嘘だから。
これはただの、条件反射なんだから。
findings.todokanai: Because it's all a lie. What we'll do from now on will be nothing but a conditional reflex.
